title: Signed full-Haar average of the literal Gaussian precision formula is rotation/reflection invariant, with genuine fixed-vector L1 and no Gaussian-law premise.
source_anchor: Only conjugation covariance and signed full-Haar rotation invariance of the literal centered Gaussian formula sqrt(det A)/(2pi)^(n/2) exp(-x^T A x/2).
